verdict.rationale: Insomnia has strong first-party documentation for collections, folders, environments (global/collection/folder scoped), Collection Runner for rerunning multiple requests in order, unlimited collection runs, and Git Sync/Cloud Sync for persisting and reusing collections. Community evidence corroborates general usability but doesn't specifically address organization/rerun workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of folder organization and rerun reliability, and any documented limits or friction reported by users on collection reruns.
